Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference for Greenfield Health

Hi Marissa,

I signed up via the Redwood free tier yesterday and would love to schedule a demo to understand how Redwood could fit into Greenfield Health's roadmap. We're evaluating inference platforms for two main use cases: clinical note summarization and NLP-based triage.

Quick context: we ingest clinical notes from our EHR and want to generate structured summaries and risk flags. Expected volume is roughly 80-120k inference requests/month initially, with an aggressive pilot timeline aiming for a Q2 start. HIPAA/compliance is a hard requirement.

Would appreciate a short intro + product walkthrough next week. Our engineering lead (cc'd on future threads) can join.

Thanks,

Hi Samir — great to meet you and thanks for signing up. Happy to run a quick 30-minute demo and walk through fit for clinical summarization + compliance controls. A few quick qualification Qs so I can tailor the demo: 

- Primary use case: you mentioned summarization + triage — is the pilot focused on batched backfill, synchronous API calls from an app, or both?
- Expected concurrency / latency needs (p95 target)?
- Estimated monthly token/request volume (you mentioned 80-120k requests — is that per month, and average tokens per request?)
- Data residency & compliance: do you require a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or is a hosted, SOC2 + BAA-enabled plan sufficient for pilot?
- Integrations: which EHR(s) are you using (Epic, Cerner, other)?

If helpful, pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min — otherwise, my availability next week is Tue 2/24 10:00-11:30 PST or Wed 2/25 13:00-16:00 PST.

Attaching a short one-pager on the Redwood platform for context.

Looking forward to it — I can also loop in our solutions engineer for a deeper technical convo if you expect to discuss KV caching or batching strategy during the pilot.

Best,

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the quick follow-up. Answers below (quoting your questions):

> Primary use case: you mentioned summarization + triage — is the pilot focused on batched backfill, synchronous API calls from an app, or both?

Both. We plan a small backfill (2-4 weeks of historical notes) to validate quality, then a synchronous pilot integrated into our clinician portal for triage alerts.

> Expected concurrency / latency needs (p95 target)?

Latency: p95 < 1.5s for synchronous requests (these are short summaries, ~150-300 tokens output). Concurrency: modest — initial concurrent load ~10-20 rps, scaling to 50 rps if pilot expands.

> Estimated monthly token/request volume (you mentioned 80-120k requests — is that per month, and average tokens per request?)

Yes, 100k requests/month is our estimate. Average prompt + response ~1.5k tokens total per request (we're still profiling).

> Data residency & compliance: do you require a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or is a hosted, SOC2 + BAA-enabled plan sufficient for pilot?

Pilot requires BAA and SOC2 + access to audit logs. For longer-term, we will evaluate private deployment options (VPC or dedicated) depending on performance and cost.

> Integrations: which EHR(s) are you using (Epic, Cerner, other)?

Epic for core notes; FHIR adapters in place.

We can do Wed 2/25 13:30-14:00 PST (your suggested window). Please include a solutions engineer and someone from product if possible. Also sending a short requirements doc for your review.

Samir Patel
Head of Data Platforms, Greenfield Health
Attachment: Greenfield_Requirements.pdf
